title: Phillips cipher admissibility (block-mod-8 selector vs cribs)

insights: Phillips selector b(i)=floor(i/5) mod 8 puts 6 CONFLICTING crib pairs in the same block (monochromatic) -> a single square cannot satisfy them. Example: {'posA': 22, 'posB': 65, 'block': 4, 'cribA': 'E->F', 'cribB': 'E->Y'}.
